findings.evidence: page_unmap_locked_result removes final hash membership before x86_clear_range_old_effects_result releases physical pages; mckernel_free_pages then performs another lookup and can bypass pending enqueue.
findings.required: Capture generation-bearing descriptor ownership under the hash lock before removal, route physical release through that captured owner and define destruction/reuse hooks. count is a mapping reference, not a lifetime pin.

findings.evidence: xpmem_detach_body_result unpins and clears private_data before munmap and discards its result; detach_att/clear_ptes have analogous behavior; free_process_range logs clear errors then unreferences and frees.
findings.required: Register attachment/AP/segment/backing ownership and a partial-clear journal before unpin, split or removal; retain VA exclusion through recovery.

findings.evidence: xpmem_detach_body_result takes VM-range then attachment while xpmem_detach_att_body_result takes attachment then VM-range; current noirq locks disable preemption but not interrupts.
findings.required: Normalize the ABBA order first; define IRQ-save pending leases, allocation restrictions and an unlocked shootdown phase with retained reservations.

findings.evidence: mem_tlb_flush_handler_body_result receives only a vector slot, dereferences its raw address pointer and decrements its counter; senders wait indefinitely and x86 clear frees address storage after a void callback.
findings.required: Define target-specific acknowledgement ownership, publish ordering, duplicate handling and nonreused slot retirement; retain address storage through the last possible late reader.

findings.evidence: process_release_vm_body_result closes descriptors, calls callbacks, frees ranges, detaches the address space and frees VM storage at zero without a registry handoff.
findings.required: Register at VM initialization and hand off before destructive release, including initialization rollback and cycle resolution. Bind restart-persistent OS epoch allocation, IRQ quiescence and an enumerable quarantine owner surviving OS destruction.

scope_correction: A private module may preserve public layouts, but the three proposed call sites are insufficient. Required edits extend to page lifetime, x86 clear/TLB bodies, XPMEM attachment teardown and Rust VM lifecycle.
